description: Indicator definitions for the Airmid Éireann monthly trend report. Read by tools/monthly_trends.py. Every figure in a report is computed from these definitions and the named dataset files; nothing is typed by hand.

conventions.kind: event = one row per dated event, months with no rows count as zero; period = the dataset carries its own month or year field, a missing period is missing data; snapshot = dated stock snapshots, the latest snapshot inside each month is used
conventions.date_format: iso = YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM (first 7 characters give the month); dmy = DD/MM/YYYY; year = YYYY
conventions.filter_ops: eq, ne, in, not_in, regex, not_regex, nonempty, empty, gt, ge, lt, le (gt..le compare numbers)
conventions.aggregation: count = rows; count_distinct = distinct values of keys; sum = sum of a numeric field; share = 100 x numerator / denominator, where the numerator is the denominator rows that also pass numerator_filter; value = the single published value of each period
conventions.window: 1 = the reference month alone; 12 = the 12 months ending with the reference month (all 12 must be complete)
conventions.lag_months: months to step back from the last month that ended before collection, because the publisher adds records for a month some time after it ends
conventions.min_n: if the count behind a figure, or behind a comparison period, is below min_n, percentage changes are not given and the indicator is flagged small_n
conventions.completeness: period datasets only: a month is complete when the number of distinct key values reaches min_ratio x the highest number seen in the previous 12 months

indicators.title: Human medicines first authorised in Ireland (HPRA register)
indicators.definition: Products on the HPRA human medicines register whose authorised_date falls in the month. The register lists products authorised now (or with transfer pending), so products later withdrawn drop out of earlier months.
notes: Survivorship: the register is a current list, so counts for past months can fall as products are withdrawn.
The HPRA can add products to the register some weeks after authorisation; the latest month can rise in later editions.

indicators.title: EU marketing authorisations for medicines evaluated by EMA, 12 months
indicators.definition: Medicines in EMA's list of human medicines whose marketing authorisation date falls in the 12 months ending with the reference month (any current status, including later withdrawn).
notes: Monthly counts are small (often under 15), so a 12-month total is used.

indicators.title: EU orphan designations, 12 months
indicators.definition: EU orphan designations whose designation date falls in the 12 months ending with the reference month, excluding negative outcomes (status Negative).
notes: EMA publishes designation pages some weeks after the European Commission decision; a two-month lag is applied.

indicators.title: US FDA original approvals of new drug and biologic applications (NDA and BLA)
indicators.definition: Drugs@FDA applications of type NDA or BLA whose original approval date falls in the month. Generic applications (ANDA) are excluded.
notes: Comparator series (United States).

indicators.title: Medicine shortages first published by EMA, 12 months
indicators.definition: Entries in EMA's medicine shortages list whose first publication date falls in the 12 months ending with the reference month. EMA lists shortages that affect more than one EU member state or that it is coordinating; national shortages in Ireland are not included.
notes: Small counts: the list holds 85 entries in total.

indicators.title: MHRA drug and device alerts and Drug Safety Update articles (UK)
indicators.definition: GOV.UK items from the MHRA drug and device alerts list and the Drug Safety Update whose issued date falls in the month.
notes: Comparator series (United Kingdom).

indicators.title: EMA periodic safety update single assessment (PSUSA) outcomes published
indicators.definition: Distinct PSUSA procedure numbers whose outcome was first published by EMA in the month.
notes: The dataset starts with EMA's late-2023 publication format; earlier outcomes are not included.

indicators.title: US FDA warning letters posted (human drugs, biologics and devices)
indicators.definition: Warning letters about human drugs, biologics or medical devices whose posted date on fda.gov falls in the month.
notes: Posted date is used rather than issue date because FDA posts letters days to weeks after issuing them.
Comparator series (United States).

indicators.title: US FDA medical device recall events first reported
indicators.definition: Distinct FDA recall events (event_id) whose first appearance in the FDA Enforcement Report (report_date) falls in the month. One event can cover several products.
notes: Report date is used rather than recall initiation date, which is filled in for recent months only after FDA classifies the recall.
Comparator series (United States).

indicators.title: Studies with a site in Ireland starting, 12 months
indicators.definition: ClinicalTrials.gov studies with at least one site in Ireland whose start date (actual or anticipated, as registered) falls in the 12 months ending with the reference month. Withdrawn studies are excluded.
notes: Studies are often registered, or add an Irish site, after they start, so recent months rise in later snapshots. A three-month lag is applied and the figure is still provisional.

indicators.title: Ireland's share of studies with a European site, 12 months
indicators.definition: Of ClinicalTrials.gov studies with at least one site in Europe that start in the 12 months ending with the reference month (withdrawn excluded), the percentage that also list a site in Ireland.
notes: Changes in a share are shown in percentage points.
Same registration lag as the Ireland count.

indicators.title: Ireland's exports of medicinal and pharmaceutical products (SITC 54), all partners
indicators.definition: Eurostat monthly trade value of SITC 54 exports declared by Ireland, partner WORLD, in euro million.
notes: Eurostat publishes monthly trade about six to seven weeks after the month; recent months are provisional and revised.
Values are not seasonally adjusted. Monthly pharmaceutical trade is volatile.

indicators.title: Ireland's exports of medicinal and pharmaceutical products to the United States
indicators.definition: CSO table TSM10 value of SITC 54 exports from Ireland to the United States, in euro million.
notes: CSO publishes goods exports about six weeks after the month; recent months are provisional.
Source values are in euro thousand; divided by 1,000.

indicators.title: Ireland's share of EU member states' pharmaceutical exports
indicators.definition: Ireland's SITC 54 exports to all partners as a percentage of the sum of SITC 54 exports to all partners declared by the 27 EU member states (Eurostat monthly data). A month is used only when every member state has reported.
notes: Member states' exports include trade between member states, so the denominator double counts goods that move within the EU. The share describes declared exports, not EU production.
Changes in a share are shown in percentage points.

indicators.title: Industrial production index, modern sector (seasonally adjusted)
indicators.definition: CSO table MIM05 industrial production volume index for the modern sector (NACE 18.2, 20, 21, 26, 27 and 32.5, which includes pharmaceuticals), seasonally adjusted, base year 2021 = 100.
notes: The modern sector is wider than pharmaceuticals (NACE 21) alone; CSO does not publish a monthly NACE 21 index in this table.
CSO revises recent months.

indicators.title: Prescription items dispensed in the community, England
indicators.definition: Sum of items over all BNF chemical substances in NHSBSA Prescription Cost Analysis for the month, in millions.
notes: NHSBSA publishes about two months after the month.
Month-on-month changes reflect the number of working days in each month.

indicators.title: Net ingredient cost of prescriptions dispensed in the community, England
indicators.definition: Sum of net ingredient cost (list price before discounts, excluding fees) over all BNF chemical substances for the month, GBP million.
notes: Net ingredient cost is not the actual cost to the NHS.

indicators.title: GP prescription items dispensed, Northern Ireland
indicators.definition: Sum of items over all rows of the BSO GP prescribing data for the month, in millions.
notes: The BSO publishes about two months after the month.

indicators.title: Actual cost of GP prescribing, Northern Ireland
indicators.definition: Sum of actual cost over all rows of the BSO GP prescribing data for the month, GBP million.

indicators.title: Prescription items dispensed under the GMS scheme, Ireland (annual)
indicators.definition: Department of Health Key Trends table KTA38, statistic 'Number of items dispensed', as published.
notes: Annual series; only year-on-year change applies.
The published unit label is '000 but the values (about 71 in 2024) read as millions of items; the value is reported exactly as published.

indicators.title: Total cost of prescriptions under the GMS scheme, Ireland (annual)
indicators.definition: Department of Health Key Trends table KTA38, statistic 'Total Cost of Prescriptions', as published.
notes: Annual series; only year-on-year change applies.
The published unit label is EUR but the values (about 1.09 million in 2024) read as EUR thousand; the value is reported exactly as published.

indicators.title: People waiting for a first outpatient appointment, Ireland
indicators.definition: Sum of total waiting over all hospitals in NTPF report OPNational01 (outpatient by hospital, adult and child), latest snapshot in the month.
notes: Snapshot dates are the last Thursday of the month or close to it; the date used is shown.

indicators.title: People waiting for an inpatient or day case procedure, Ireland (GI endoscopy excluded)
indicators.definition: Sum of total waiting over all hospitals in NTPF report IPDCNational01 (inpatient/day case by hospital, adult and child), latest snapshot in the month.

indicators.title: People waiting for GI endoscopy, Ireland
indicators.definition: Sum of total waiting over all hospitals in NTPF report IPDCNational04 (GI endoscopy by hospital), latest snapshot in the month.

indicators.title: People waiting 18 months or more, all three NTPF lists
indicators.definition: Sum of waiting_18_plus_months over NTPF reports OPNational01, IPDCNational01 and IPDCNational04 (outpatient, inpatient/day case and GI endoscopy, by hospital), latest snapshot in the month.
notes: A person on more than one list is counted once per list.

indicators.title: EU-funded health research projects with an Irish participant starting, 12 months
indicators.definition: CORDIS Horizon 2020 and Horizon Europe health projects with at least one organisation in Ireland (participant country IE, any role) whose start date falls in the 12 months ending with the reference month.
notes: Projects appear in CORDIS when the grant is signed, which can be after the start date; recent months can rise.

indicators.title: Ireland's share of European pharmacology and drug discovery publications, 12 months
indicators.definition: Of OpenAlex works in the European pharmacology, pharmaceutics, toxicology and drug discovery set (EU-27, UK, Norway, Switzerland) published in the 12 months ending with the reference month, the percentage with an author affiliation in Ireland (country IE).
notes: OpenAlex indexes works some weeks after publication; a two-month lag is applied.
Works without a full publication date are often dated 1 January, which inflates January; the 12-month window absorbs this.
Changes in a share are shown in percentage points.

indicators.title: Research Ireland and SFI grant commitments starting in the year
indicators.definition: Rows of the Research Ireland and Science Foundation Ireland grant commitment files with a positive amount whose start date falls in the calendar year.
notes: Annual series; only year-on-year change applies.
The current Research Ireland file is published irregularly and ran to January 2026 when collected; grants that started in 2025 can still be added.
From August 2024 the source file changed (SFI to Research Ireland), and supplements are no longer separate rows; counts either side of that change are not strictly comparable.

indicators.title: Parliamentary questions on medicines, drugs, pharmaceuticals and the HPRA
indicators.definition: Oireachtas parliamentary questions (written and oral) to the Departments of Health and Enterprise matching the medicines topic terms, by date in the official record.
notes: The Dáil does not sit in August and sits less in December; zero or low counts in those months reflect the sitting calendar.
Year-on-year comparison is the more informative one for this series.

indicators.title: Health contract awards published on eTenders, Ireland
indicators.definition: Distinct health procurement notices or contracts (tender_id and title) on eTenders whose award published date falls in the month.
notes: Not every contract has an award notice on eTenders; the series counts published awards only.

indicators.title: Share of health contract awards with at least one SME supplier, 12 months
indicators.definition: Of distinct health awards on eTenders (tender_id and title, each counted once) whose award published date falls in the 12 months ending with the reference month and that publish a number of awarded SMEs, the percentage with one or more awarded SMEs.
notes: Awarded contract values are not used as an indicator: framework and panel awards publish ceiling values (up to EUR 700 million for one award), so a monthly or 12-month total is dominated by a handful of notices.
Changes in a share are shown in percentage points.

indicators.title: Waste transferred off site by Irish chemical and pharmaceutical facilities (annual)
indicators.definition: Sum of quantity (tonnes) of waste transfer records reported to EEA Industrial Reporting (E-PRTR) by the Irish chemical and pharmaceutical facilities in the dataset, by reporting year.
notes: Annual series; only year-on-year change applies. EEA publishes a reporting year about 15 to 18 months after it ends.
Only facilities above E-PRTR reporting thresholds report.
